WIJAYA_ERP_SETTINGS.TITLE: ERPNext Settings
WIJAYA_ERP_SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Connect this account to your ERPNext instance so the conversation sidebar can create and update Leads. Credentials are stored encrypted and are never shown again.

HOST.LABEL: ERPNext Host
HOST.HINT: Origin only (https://host), no path. HTTP is allowed only for local development hosts.

API_KEY.LABEL: API Key
API_KEY.HINT: Leave blank to keep the stored key.
API_KEY.PRESENT: A key is saved for this account.
API_KEY.PRESENT_ENV: Using the deployment-wide key from the environment.

API_SECRET.LABEL: Secret Key
API_SECRET.HINT: Leave blank to keep the stored secret.
API_SECRET.PRESENT: A secret is saved for this account.
API_SECRET.PRESENT_ENV: Using the deployment-wide secret from the environment.

SAVE.ERROR: Could not save the ERPNext settings.
